title: Reintroductions can backfire by destabilising food webs and triggering further extinction cascades: analysis code and simulation data
description: Analysis v0.4 for the predator reintroduction study. This release contains the annotated R Markdown analysis, a self-contained HTML report with all eleven marginal-effect plots and the approved summary figures, analysis-ready simulation data, a data dictionary, and paired-bootstrap predictions. The preserved-feeding-link experiment comprised 11,614 community simulations across intact, extirpated and reintroduced phases; 10,969 simulations with usable predator biomass ratios were retained for analysis. See the README and HTML report for instructions, methods, results and limitations.
